preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and the distance limit d are within the specified bounds.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes within the range 1 to n.
The number of nodes in the first piece's sequence is within the specified bounds.
The number of nodes in the second piece's sequence is within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n for a in a_sequence)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the first piece's sequence are within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= n for b in b_sequence)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the second piece's sequence are within the range 1 to n.
All nodes in the first piece's sequence are distinct.
All nodes in the second piece's sequence are distinct.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of steps is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(distance_between_pieces <= d for distance_between_pieces in distances)
postconditions.description: The distance between the two pieces never exceeds d during the sequence of moves.

postconditions.expression: all(node in a_sequence for node in a_visited) and all(node in b_sequence for node in b_visited)
postconditions.description: Both pieces visit all nodes in their respective sequences.
Both pieces return to the root node at the end of their sequences.
